newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed in distribution pact with Leica.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed in distribution pact with Leica.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said Tuesday it has signed a contract under which Leica Microscopy and Systems GmbH will distribute, outside of the Western Hemisphere, AccuMed's system of screening cells.

Peter Gombrich, chairman of AccuMed, said that this contract is crucial to AccuMed. "This puts both companies in an excellent position to participate in the International Expert Conference on Diagnostic Cytology towards the 21st Century in Hawaii in early June," he said in a statement.
Leica, based in Wetzlar, Germany develops precision microscopy and imaging technology. It will be the exclusive distributor in Europe, Asia and other world markets.
AccuMed makes and markets disposable tests and instrument systems and automated cytopathology systems used in the screening of cell specimens marketed under the AcCell name.

Under terms of this contract, shipment of AcCell systems will begin in second quarter of 1997. Leica will have exclusive distribution rights for the AcCell system in the designated markets, and the right of first negotiation to be AccuMed's exclusive distributor in a territory for future cytology products.
